item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R04-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R04-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R04-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt reported that recruitment firms were monitored and supervised; 130 of 300 recruitment bureaux had been modernized and expanded, 251 firms had been licensed, 1,231 licences renewed, and 112 revoked, bringing the total number of licensed firms to 1,482.","notes":["The excerpt does not support a general claim that the Ministry of Labour monitored and inspected enterprises.","The excerpt concerns recruitment bureaux and firms, not vocational-training centres.","It says 251 firms were licensed, not necessarily newly licensed."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R04-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R04-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt reported that 112 recruitment-firm licences had been revoked while recruitment firms were monitored and kept under supervision.","notes":["The excerpt does not state that the revocations involved non-compliance or establish an enforcement rationale."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R04-E006","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt concerns migrant demographics, international instruments, and court rulings; it does not support claims about vocational-training centres, skills development, mutual recognition of qualifications, or employment opportunities."]}]}
